gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Light, techy and well spaced. Quantum sets the tone with no calligraphic modulation, while Noto Sans Marchen answers underneath with proud small letters whose curves end in clear daylight, so the two read as one clean voice.

gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-medefaid: Tech-clean and loosely spaced, with constant stroke width. Quantum leads, and Noto Sans Medefaidrin follows in a plain sans whose lowercase rises high, with no ink pooling where curves turn; give the heading generous size.

gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-mende-ki: Wire-thin strokes, generous spacing, a crisp tech feel. And Noto Sans Mende Kikakui carries a longer passage easily, daylight showing through every curve while its tall lowercase stands up against the capitals.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Quantum draws one unbroken line weight, crisp and loosely spaced. And Noto Sans Meroitic backs it with see-through c openings and lowercase that fills the line like capitals, so the page feels consistent.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-modi: Crisp, open and a touch futuristic. Yet Noto Sans Modi brings the pair's strongest quality, daylight inside every curve and little gap between capital and lowercase height, matching Quantum's matched-arch n.
